about: Single source of the code templates library and of the numbered circles on the architecture images. A template with a number has a circle on the images; place says where. Run documentation/gh-io/tools/generate_architecture.py after you change a number or a place.

skipped.usecase_code/30-machine-learning: Empty placeholder. The machine-learning templates are in 50-ml-model-factory.

places.teams: Microsoft 365, through Bot Service to the agent
places.voice: Voice Live in the Foundry project
places.fabric: Microsoft Fabric, into the Foundry tools
places.gateway: AI gateway: API Management or Kong
places.ml: From the Foundry agent to Azure Machine Learning
places.agents: Prompt agents in the Foundry project
places.hosted: Hosted agents in the Foundry project
places.chat: Container Apps: the Agent Chat app

templates.title: ESAF agent with a private web chat, ready for Teams
templates.summary: A Foundry prompt agent grounded in Azure AI Search, with a private web chat. Publish it to Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot with enableBotService and botFoundryAgentName.

templates.title: Live voice for the ESAF agent
templates.summary: A pipeline step that deploys the private chat app with Azure Voice Live, so that people talk to the agent and hear it answer.

templates.title: Voice sales assistant on Fabric data
templates.summary: A sales assistant in the browser: a Foundry prompt agent answers from a Fabric data agent over MCP, with optional live voice.

templates.title: Retail agents on Foundry IQ and Fabric IQ
templates.summary: A supervisor routes retail questions to three prompt agents, grounded in a Foundry IQ knowledge base and a Fabric data agent.

templates.title: RAG that keeps each reader's permissions
templates.summary: RAG over several indexes that trims answers with the ADLS Gen2 access control lists, with an optional SharePoint sync and exact totals from a calculator tool.

templates.title: Private Azure MCP server for your agents
templates.summary: A private, read-only Azure MCP server on Container Apps, so that Foundry agents can list the real resources of the project.

templates.title: Factory MCP server on the AI gateway
templates.summary: A pipeline step that hosts the read-only Factory MCP server on Container Apps and registers it on the AI gateway in API Management.

templates.title: Agent that trains and scores ML models
templates.summary: A Foundry agent that creates, trains, retrains and batch-scores Azure Machine Learning models for churn prediction.

templates.title: Single agent: prompt agent or hosted agent
templates.summary: A helpdesk agent that answers from Foundry IQ. Choose a prompt agent, or a hosted agent in one of six frameworks.

templates.title: Multi-agent helpdesk: retrieve, review, answer
templates.summary: A hosted coordinator asks a knowledge agent for evidence, passes it to a reviewer agent and writes one reviewed answer.

templates.title: RAG from the shared data lake or project storage
templates.summary: Text RAG over a pinned corpus in the common data lake or in project storage, with one agent, index and knowledge base for each source.

templates.title: Prepare a helpdesk corpus for RAG
templates.summary: Prepares a public helpdesk dataset for private Foundry IQ retrieval, and keeps the evaluation answers apart from the searchable knowledge.

templates.title: ESAF Agent Chat: the agent behind it
templates.summary: The pipeline step that creates or updates the Agent Chat prompt agent in the project when enableFactoryChatAgent is true.

templates.title: ML Model Factory
templates.summary: Machine-learning examples for batch, online and streaming inference with Azure Machine Learning, AutoML and Databricks, driven by one scenario file.

templates.title: Factory lifecycle as an Azure Function
templates.summary: An Azure Function that runs the six ESAF scenarios, from creating a Factory to deleting it, so that a portal or a ticket system can order projects.

templates.title: Azure Function that reads from storage
templates.summary: An HTTP-triggered Azure Function that lists and reads blobs with its managed identity, with a health endpoint.

templates.title: Starter: prompt agent with RAG in one file
templates.summary: One script that indexes a sample document in Azure AI Search and answers questions with a Foundry prompt agent on the Responses API.

templates.title: Starter: prompt agent with a Fabric data agent
templates.summary: One script in which a Foundry prompt agent answers questions through a Microsoft Fabric data agent tool.

templates.title: Foundry prompt agents
templates.summary: Declarative prompt agents for knowledge, review and documentation. They need no application server.

templates.title: Hosted agent: Microsoft Agent Framework
templates.summary: A Foundry-hosted Python agent built with Microsoft Agent Framework that answers from the evidence of the knowledge agent.

templates.title: Hosted agent: LangGraph
templates.summary: A Foundry-hosted agent that runs a small LangGraph graph and answers from the evidence of the knowledge agent.

templates.title: Hosted agent: OpenAI Agents SDK
templates.summary: A Foundry-hosted agent on the OpenAI Agents SDK, with the model on your Foundry endpoint and evidence from the knowledge agent.

templates.title: Hosted agent: GitHub Copilot SDK
templates.summary: A Foundry-hosted agent that uses the GitHub Copilot SDK as its runtime, with a model from Microsoft Foundry.

templates.title: Hosted agent: Claude on Foundry
templates.summary: A Foundry-hosted agent that answers grounded questions with a Claude model deployed in Foundry, through the Anthropic Messages SDK.

templates.title: Hosted agent: your own code on the Responses API
templates.summary: A minimal Foundry-hosted Python agent that calls the Responses API itself after the knowledge agent returns the evidence.

templates.title: Batch classification with an Azure ML pipeline
templates.summary: Trains a classification model and scores a dataset in batch with an Azure Machine Learning pipeline. Tested in Azure.

templates.title: Batch regression with an Azure ML pipeline
templates.summary: Trains a regression model and scores a dataset in batch with an Azure Machine Learning pipeline. Tested in Azure.

templates.title: Batch forecasting with an Azure ML pipeline
templates.summary: Trains a time-series forecasting model and scores in batch with an Azure Machine Learning pipeline. Tested in Azure.

templates.title: Batch forecasting in a notebook
templates.summary: Trains a time-series forecasting model and scores in batch from a notebook. Tested in Azure.

templates.title: Batch multi-label image classification with an Azure ML pipeline
templates.summary: Trains a multi-label image classification model and scores images in batch with an Azure Machine Learning pipeline. Tested in Azure.

templates.title: Batch multi-label image classification in a notebook
templates.summary: Trains a multi-label image classification model and scores images in batch from a notebook. Tested in Azure.

templates.title: Batch object detection with an Azure ML pipeline
templates.summary: Trains an object detection model and scores images in batch with an Azure Machine Learning pipeline. Tested in Azure.

templates.title: Batch object detection in a notebook
templates.summary: Trains an object detection model and scores images in batch from a notebook. Tested in Azure.
